[EN] Into the Furnace
[ES] Directo al horno
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hope we don't run out of time.
[ES] Esperemos que no se nos agote el tiempo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask {@linkcreature:528#5005#Tamur} at {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} how the apprentice is doing.
[ES] Pregúntale a {@linkcreature:528#5005#Tamur} en {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} cómo le va al aprendiz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet the escaped human apprentice.
[ES] Reúnete con el aprendiz human que escapó.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Primus Gahreed about the escaped apprentice.
[ES] Pregúntale al primus Gahreed sobre el aprendiz escapado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the escaped {@linkcreature:79#1100#human apprentice} from the Divine Furnace, and ask about the situation at the Divine Furnace.
[ES] Ve con el {@linkcreature:79#1100#aprendiz human} escapado de Divine Furnace y pregúntale sobre la situación allí.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Primus Gahreed about where the escaped apprentice was rescued.
[ES] Pregúntale al primus Gahreed dónde rescataron al aprendiz escapado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's get you to safety!"
[ES] "¡Te llevaré a un lugar seguro!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm saved! Thank you!
[ES] ¡Estoy a salvo! ¡Gracias!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the horse carriage and rescue the apprentices, then escort them safely to Habere.
[ES] Destruye el carruaje de caballos y rescata a los aprendices, luego escórtalos a salvo hasta Habere.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find out about the situation at the Divine Furnace from the rescued popori apprentices.
[ES] Entérate de la situación en Divine Furnace por los aprendices popori rescatados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Popori Apprentice
[ES] Aprendiz popori
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thulsa's Shield Schematic
[ES] Plano del escudo de Thulsa
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Show Engineer Gaicus the schematic and ask how the shield can be destroyed.
[ES] Muéstrale el plano al ingeniero Gaicus y pregúntale cómo se puede destruir el escudo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll get it."
[ES] "Yo lo conseguiré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Molten Chamber entrance
[ES] Entrada a Molten Chamber
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You found the entrance to the Molten Chamber.
[ES] Encontraste la entrada a Molten Chamber.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the entrance of the Molten Chamber of the Divine Furnace.
[ES] Ve a la entrada de Molten Chamber en Divine Furnace.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Muhrak in the Molten Chamber. [You can enter the Molten Chamber by using a teleportal, after destroying Thulsa's Magic Stone.]
[ES] Busca a Muhrak en Molten Chamber. [Puedes entrar a Molten Chamber usando un teleportal tras destruir la piedra mágica de Thulsa.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Let's move! Meet me in my workshop in Habere.
[ES] ¡En marcha! Reúnete conmigo en mi taller en Habere.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Protect Muhrak from the Legion of Thulsa. [You can proceed by selecting "You organized yourself." after speaking with Muhrak.]
[ES] Protege a Muhrak de la Legión de Thulsa. [Puedes continuar seleccionando "Te organizaste tú solo" después de hablar con Muhrak.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I see."
[ES] "Ya veo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the {@linkcreature:79#1501#Teleportal} to enter the workshop and speak to Muhrak.
[ES] Usa el {@linkcreature:79#1501#Teleportal} para entrar al taller y hablar con Muhrak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
